name: Thrak Skullsplitter

abilities.name: Reckless Charge
abilities.description: Charges forward with weapon raised, sacrificing defense for devastating offense

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.description: Brings weapon down with all strength to shatter shields and bones

appearance.hair: shaved bald with tribal war paint
appearance.distinctive_features: Massive scar across face from forehead to jaw, filed teeth, brand mark on shoulder showing slave status

personality.demeanor: Always spoiling for a fight, shifts weight anxiously, grins at signs of violence
personality.speaking_style: Loud and boastful, frequently challenges others, laughs at pain (his own and others')

beliefs: Fighting is the only thing that matters
Pain is weakness leaving the body
philosophy.approach_to_conflict: Charges directly at enemies with no regard for tactics or self-preservation. Lives for combat and will pursue enemies even when ordered to hold position. Targets whoever looks most fun to fight. Gets more aggressive when wounded. May disobey orders if he thinks a better fight is available elsewhere.

visible: Massive two-handed maul covered in dried blood
Collection of enemy teeth on a necklace
hidden: Stolen coins sewn into armor lining
Small knife for eating and torture

secrets: Branded as a slave by the Witch King - magically compelled to guard this room
Dreams of killing the Witch King but physically cannot harm him due to the brand
Hates Gruk and wants to prove he's the stronger warrior
backstory: Captured during a raid on his tribe and magically enslaved by the Witch King. The brand on his shoulder compels absolute obedience on pain of agonizing death. Channels his rage at captivity into violence against anyone who enters the throne room. Hopes someone will kill the Witch King and break his enslavement.
